''Senecio welwitschii'' O.Hoffm. |synonyms_ref = {{cite web |url = http://www.ville-ge.ch/cjb/bd/africa/details.php?langue=an&id=101881 |archive-url = https://archive.today/20130115204621/http://www.ville-ge.ch/cjb/bd/africa/details.php?langue=an&id=101881 |url-status = dead |archive-date = 2013-01-15 |title = ''Kleinia fulgens'' record n° 101881 |access-date = 2008-05-22 |work = African Plants Database |publisher = [[Natural History Museum of Geneva|South African National Biodiversity Institute, the Conservatoire et Jardin botaniques de la Ville de Genève]] and Tela Botanica }} }} '''''Kleinia fulgens''''', commonly known as the '''coral senecio''', is a [[species]] of flowering plant in the [[genus]] ''[[Kleinia]]'' and the family [[Asteraceae]] native to [[Southern Africa]], which used to be of the genus ''[[Senecio]]''.{{cite web |url=http://www.sntc.org.sz/flora/speciesinfo.asp?spid=3362 |title=Species Information: ''Kleinia fulgens'' Hook.f. |access-date=2008-05-22 |work=Swaziland's Flora Database |quote=Compton's Flora of Swaziland |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110614062844/http://www.sntc.org.sz/flora/speciesinfo.asp?spid=3362 |archive-date=2011-06-14 }} ==Range== [[File:Kleinia fulgens 2019-12-13 6076.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Detail of leaves]] It is native to the countries [[Angola]], [[Mozambique]], [[Swaziland]], [[Zambia]], and [[Zimbabwe]], as well as to [[KwaZulu-Natal]] and the [[Northern Provinces]] in [[South Africa]].{{Cite web |title=Kleinia fulgens |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:227384-1 |access-date=2024-07-07 |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Kew Science |language=en}} ==Description== It is a perennial [[herbaceous]] plant with a rather soft stem and [[succulent]] leaves, extensive, up to 60 cm long, without long hair. Leaves narrow down to the base of the wings, oval with prominent triangular pointed teeth, total length up to 15 cm x 5 cm wide.{{Citation needed|date=July 2024}} There are few flowerheads which resemble a [[thistle]]; involucral [[bracts]] few, very unequal in width, membranous with border, up to 2 cm long; disk 2.5 cm in diameter; without rays, [[Petal|corolla]] crimson, scarlet or cherry in colour. The flowers appear from late autumn to winter.[https://www.llifle.com/Encyclopedia/SUCCULENTS/Family/Asteraceae/30411/Senecio_fulgens Senecio fulgens (Hook.f.) G.Nicholson] LLIFLE - Encyclopedia of living forms.
